unruled:aqee#1.evidence: i8863 pp. 4, 9. aqee.inst is bound from dependent.edu_inst / person.edu_inst, which state payment in 2025 by anyone, periods beginning in 2025 or January to March 2026, amounts actually paid rather than Form 1098-T box 1, no 2024 or 2026 payments, and the personal-expense and sports/hobby/noncredit exclusions with the degree and job-skills exceptions.

unruled:aqee#2.evidence: i8863 p. 4. aqee.mat is bound from dependent.edu_mat / person.edu_mat: 'paid for in 2025' and 'the same exclusions as for the expenses paid to the institution' (which exclude 2024 and 2026 payments and personal expenses).

unruled:aqee#3.evidence: i8863 pp. 4, 9. The def computes both paths, but the caller chooses: dependent.edu_line30 takes line30 only when dependent.edu_aoc, and dependent.edu_line31 takes ws4_llc only when dependent.edu_llc (an eligible student who is not an American opportunity credit student); the same holds for person.edu_line30/31.

unruled:carloan#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 109-110. The VIN on Schedule 1-A line 22, the substitute VIN and the statement for more than two VINs are filing information; the loan and vehicle tests are asked (carloan.requirements, carloan.vehicle).

unruled:clcw#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 10; p550 p. 102. Canceled debt excluded from income (Form 982) is refused by s1.cod_unsupported, so no attribute reduction of the carryovers arises. As sd#1 of the backlog round.

unruled:clcw26#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 10; p550 p. 103. Excluded canceled debt is refused by s1.cod_unsupported. Which spouse had a joint-return loss matters only on a 2026 separate return; the 2025 worksheet's carryover is the joint figure, and a 2025 separate return is refused (s3.mfs).

unruled:dcprov#1.evidence: i2441 pp. 2-3. dcprov is a collection with any number of providers; the box above line 1, the statement for providers beyond three and 'none' in column (a) are filing information.

unruled:dcprov#2.evidence: i2441 p. 2. dependent.dc_paid excludes 'care at a dependent care center that does not meet all applicable state and local regulations'.

unruled:eic#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 41, 45. eic.qc_count counts only dependents for whom dependent.eic_child is true, and dependent.eic_child tests dependent.us_half, which asks whether the child lived with you in the United States (the 50 states and the District of Columbia) for more than half of 2025.

unruled:eic#2.evidence: i1040gi pp. 40, 45. person.eic_ssn is asked for each person on the return (both spouses on a joint return; household.all_eic_ssn requires every person), and states that a 'Valid for Work Only With DHS Authorization' card is valid only while the authorization is valid.

unruled:eic#3.evidence: i1040gi pp. 40-41. Schedule EIC and the Dependents-section and address-block checkboxes are filing information; the qualifying-child tests are asked.

unruled:f1040#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 24-25. As the earlier rulings: scope.other_income names wages or tips not on a Form W-2, adoption benefits and other earned income (lines 1b to 1d and 1f to 1h); unreported and allocated tips are also refused by f8959.unsupported.

unruled:f1040#2.evidence: i1040gi pp. 27-28. As the earlier rulings: retirement.special names nondeductible IRA contributions, conversions and recharacterizations, returned contributions, QCDs and HSA funding distributions; rollovers are computed; the line 4c boxes are filing information.

unruled:f1040#3.evidence: i1040gi pp. 28-31. As the earlier rulings: retirement.special names the retired public safety officer exclusion, pre-retirement-age disability pensions and the Civil Service alternative annuity.

unruled:f1040#4.evidence: i1040gi p. 31. As the earlier rulings: ssb.pub915 refuses Forms 2555, 4563 and 8815, excluded adoption benefits and Puerto Rico income.

unruled:f1040#5.evidence: i1040gi pp. 14, 33-34. As the earlier rulings: married filing separately is refused (s3.mfs), so the spouse-itemizes and spouse-box rules do not arise; sa.unsupported refuses a disaster loss added to the standard deduction.

unruled:f1040#6.evidence: i1040gi pp. 34-36. scope.other_line16 refuses the other line 16 taxes, including Form 8615 and Schedule J; the section 965(i) amount is outside the tool (BUG inventory, earlier rounds).

unruled:f1040#7.evidence: i1040gi p. 39. As the earlier rulings: married filing separately is refused; line 26 is the supplied total of the filer's own payments.

unruled:f2441#1.evidence: i2441 p. 2; p503 pp. 3, 8, 10. dependent.dc_paid now states every listed rule: child support, agency reimbursement, chauffeur/bartender/gardener, schooling from kindergarten, overnight camp, summer school and tutoring, food/lodging/clothing/entertainment, noncompliant centers, the 8-hour out-of-home rule, days of work, mixed-purpose division, the qualifying-person period, housekeeper meals and lodging, employment taxes and the medical-expense bar (BUG-0334, BUG-0348).

unruled:f2441#2.evidence: i2441 p. 3; p503 p. 3. A dependent without an SSN, ITIN or ATIN, including a child born and died without an SSN, is refused by dependent.claimed_no_tin; column (c) and the attachment are filing information.

unruled:f4562#1.evidence: i4562 p. 5. f4562.line12 copies the return's Part I (s179): line 5 with the married-filing-separately 50% share and its refusal (s179.line5), the 2024 carryover (s179.line10) and the line 11 business income limit (s179.line11); a trade-in is refused by asset.screen and scveh.screen; asset.s179 requires use in the active conduct of the business.

unruled:f4562#10.evidence: i4562 pp. 14-15. asset.screen refuses listed property whose qualified business use is 50% or less after leaving out investment use, 5% owner and related-person leasing or compensation uses (the quoted exclusions); asset.pct handles conversion months; commuting miles and the section 280F limits are applied in scveh.

unruled:f4562#11.evidence: i4562 pp. 13-15. Line 27 is refused: listed property used 50% or less (asset.listed_low) gates asset.basis.

unruled:f4562#12.evidence: i4562 pp. 5, 13. Line 29 feeds Part I as s179.line7 (person.s179_listed); a section 179 election on property used 50% or less is refused by asset.after179 (asset.s179_bad) and listed property at 50% or less by asset.listed_low.

unruled:f4562#2.evidence: i4562 p. 9. Depreciation is figured on asset.after179 (basis less section 179) after the special allowance; software is refused by asset.screen unless its whole business cost is deducted in 2025 through section 179 and the special allowance; the percentage tables never exceed basis.

unruled:f4562#3.evidence: i4562 p. 9. asset.screen refuses an asset 'you disposed of' in 2025, but does not name the disposition of a portion of an asset, so the basis and reserve reduction for a partial disposition is unasked. Low; BUG-0402.

unruled:f4562#4.evidence: i4562 pp. 9, 11-12. asset.screen refuses like-kind exchanges and involuntary conversions, basis reductions other than section 179 and the special allowance, ADS, straight line and 150% elections, dispositions and short tax years; business use is asset.pct (converted property by months); the mid-quarter test is the mq form.

unruled:f4562#5.evidence: i4562 p. 10. Agricultural asset classes (01.x) map to 'outside' in class_lives (asset.outside, part of asset.screened), and farm income (Schedule F) is refused by scope.schedule1.

unruled:f4562#6.evidence: i4562 p. 11. Smart electric meters and grid systems are named in asset.screen; trees and vines bearing fruits or nuts are farm property (agricultural classes outside; Schedule F refused by scope.schedule1).

unruled:f4562#7.evidence: i4562 p. 12. Farming-business property is outside (agricultural classes 01.x, Schedule F refused by scope.schedule1), and a 150% declining balance election is refused by asset.screen.

unruled:f4562#8.evidence: i4562 pp. 11-13. asset.screen refuses property that must be depreciated under ADS (with examples) and an ADS election, and residential rental and nonresidential real property (real property is refused); Part III Section C is not reached.

unruled:f4562#9.evidence: i4562 pp. 13-14. Listed property used 50% or less is refused (asset.listed_low gates asset.basis); aircraft are refused by asset.screen; vehicles are scveh entries, whose first-year limits include the special allowance (auto_limit tables).

unruled:f4952#1.evidence: f4952 p. 3. As f4952#1 of the T-094 review (rechecked): f4952.line4d is Schedule D line 16 floored at zero (sd.line16 = sd.line7 + sd.line15), and those lines include the capital gain distributions (sd.line13) and the short- and long-term capital loss carryovers (sd.line6, sd.line14). The label does not name the carryovers; the amount includes them.

unruled:f5329#1.evidence: i5329 p. 5; p590b p. 28. retirement.exception names the exception but does not test its conditions (plan type, separation age, physician certification, reservist call-up, adoptee). Open in BUG-0369 (T-175). The 3-year emergency-distribution bar is refused by retirement.early_screen.

unruled:f5329#2.evidence: i5329 p. 5. The exception 19 statement is filing information.

unruled:f5329#3.evidence: i5329 p. 7. retirement.special refuses a 2024 or 2025 IRA contribution returned to you, with its earnings.

unruled:f5329#4.evidence: i5329 p. 8. f8889.unsupported refuses a withdrawal of excess HSA contributions or their earnings (in 2025 or by the 2025 due date including extensions); a later withdrawal is an amended-return matter.

unruled:f5695#1.evidence: i5695 p. 1, Home: "A home is where you lived in 2025". f5695.part1_any and the Part I cost questions say "a home in the United States (it need not be your main home)" and do not require that the filer lived there in 2025 or that a manufactured home meet the federal standards. Partly covered: a rented home is refused by f5695.business_use (more than 20% of use for renting out) and a home under construction by f5695.construction_later; a home neither lived in nor rented in 2025 is open. Low; BUG-0434. The wording predates R1 (kept word for word).

unruled:f5695#10.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 24b QMID statement; items without a QMID are refused is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#11.evidence: i5695 p. 7. The line 29b, 29d and 29f QMID statements; items without a QMID are refused is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#2.evidence: i5695 p. 4. The Part I home address and the statement of additional addresses is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#3.evidence: i5695 p. 5. The line 17d main-home address is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#4.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 21c addresses is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#5.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 25b enabled-property code; f5695.line25a asks the eligibility is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#6.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 19b and 19d QMIDs and the line 19e QMID statement; f5695.qmid_doors refuses an item without a QMID is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#7.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 20a QMIDs and the line 20b QMID statement; f5695.qmid_windows refuses an item without a QMID is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#8.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 22a QMID and the line 22b QMID statement; items without a QMID are refused is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#9.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 23a QMIDs and the line 23b QMID statement; items without a QMID are refused is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f8606#1.evidence: i8606 pp. 2, 9. Covered except one rule: person.ira_trad excludes contributions withdrawn with earnings and employer SEP/SIMPLE contributions; recharacterizations and excess contributions are refused by person.ira_excess. Open: no question adds a repayment of a qualified reservist distribution to line 1. Low; BUG-0402.

unruled:f8606#2.evidence: i8606 p. 2. A traditional IRA distribution with basis from any year (including an inherited IRA) answers 'nondeductible contributions to any traditional IRA' in retirement.special, which refuses it; a Roth IRA distribution other than code Q is refused by retirement.bad_code. So no nontaxable part is left uncomputed.

unruled:f8863#1.evidence: i8863 pp. 1, 3, 8. dependent.edu_aoc (and person.edu_aoc) require household.all_tin and the institution's EIN (dependent.edu_ein); dependent.edu_student requires the student's TIN by the due date (dependent.tin; person.tin says issued by the due date). The filer-TIN reading is recorded as amb.2025.edu_filer_tin.

unruled:f8863#2.evidence: i8863 p. 1. dependent.edu_student requires dependent.edu_1098t (person.edu_1098t for the filers), which asks whether a Form 1098-T was received and states the exceptions (not required, or requested after February 2, 2026; amb.2025.edu_1098t_date).

unruled:f8880#1.evidence: f8880 p. 2 (as the prior ruling; the claim repeats it). Line 2 is person.sav_line2 = person.sav_w2 (Form W-2 box 12 deferrals) + person.sav_voluntary + person.sav_simple. person.sav_voluntary's question excludes 'contributions designated under section 414(h)(2) (treated as employer contributions)'. Pick-ups are shown in box 14, not as box 12 deferrals, so they do not reach person.sav_w2. The round changed only the order of f8880.can_take (AGI first) and which contributions its test counts.

unruled:f8889#1.evidence: i8889 p. 2, Qualified Medical Expenses: nonprescription medicines, menstrual care products, condoms and COVID-19 protective equipment qualify for HSA purposes though not deductible on Schedule A; the f8889.medical question does not say so. Pre-existing (the round changed only f8889.use_last_month); low, held for the form's next substantive change.

unruled:f8959#1.evidence: i8959 pp. 1-3. Line 8 sums person.se_line6, which is NonNegDollars per person (Schedule SE line 4c is floored at zero), so one spouse's loss never offsets the other's income.

unruled:f8995#1.evidence: i8995 p. 3. qbi.dividends asks for box 5 dividends 'after confirming holding-period and related-payment requirements'.

unruled:ftc#1.evidence: i1116 p. 2 (as the prior ruling; the claim repeats it). A foreign tax deduction on Schedule A is refused by sa.unsupported ('a foreign tax ... deduction'), so the credit and a deduction cannot both be taken.

unruled:g28#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 11. sales.special asks about the sale of 'an interest in a partnership, S corporation or trust ... that holds collectibles' and refuses it.

unruled:gift#1.evidence: i8283 p. 3. As the earlier gift#1 ruling: the attached statement of how a reduction was figured is filing information; no amount the tool computes depends on it.

unruled:gift#2.evidence: i8283 pp. 1-3. As the earlier gift#2 ruling: completing Section A's entries, the e-file data and attaching the form are filing information; the tool's gift groups apply the $500 and $5,000 thresholds and gift.special refuses Section B.

unruled:interest#1.evidence: i1040sb pp. 1-2. The interest roster's help names accrued market discount (taxable even on a tax-exempt bond) and contingent payment debt instrument gain; sb.unsupported names them and refuses; tax-exempt interest is asked separately (f1040.tax_exempt_interest).

unruled:ira#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 96. Married filing separately is refused for the whole return (s3.mfs), so the deemed-covered and lived-apart rules do not arise.

unruled:ira#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 96. A Form 8815 exclusion is refused by sb.unsupported ('a savings bond interest exclusion'); excluded employer-provided adoption benefits are refused by scope.other_income ('adoption benefits').

unruled:ira#3.evidence: i1040gi p. 95; p590a p. 35. person.ira_excess asks about contributions above $7,000/$8,000 or compensation, and person.ira_excess_gate refuses person.ira_line11.

unruled:ira#4.evidence: i1040gi p. 95. person.ira_trad excludes rollover contributions and separately billed trustees' fees.

unruled:ltc#1.evidence: i7206 p. 2. As the earlier ltc#2 ruling: sc.hi_screen refuses when "anyone is covered by qualified long-term care insurance entered for more than one business on this return (yours or your spouse's)", so one person's limit is applied on one form only.

unruled:ltc#2.evidence: i7206 p. 1. As the earlier ltc#1 ruling: sc.hi_screen refuses a more-than-2% S corporation shareholder and a retired public safety officer who paid premiums from retirement plan distributions; partnerships are not Schedule C (scope.schedule1 refuses partnership income). ltc.payments states the qualified contract requirements.

unruled:mq#1.evidence: p946 p. 34. mq.q4 sums asset.mq_q4 per entry, whose basis is asset.after179 (business-use basis after section 179, before the special allowance); real property, same-year dispositions, non-MACRS methods and a short tax year are refused by asset.screen.

unruled:mq#2.evidence: p946 p. 34. As mq#1: mq.total sums asset.mqbase over 2025 assets; the excluded property is refused by asset.screen.

unruled:otjob#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 106, 108. otjob rows are per person: s1a.line14a_calc sums person.ot_total only over persons whose person.work_ssn (SSN valid for employment, issued by the due date including extensions) is Yes, so a spouse's overtime without a valid SSN does not reach line 14a; s1a.ot_ssn gates Part III.

unruled:qbi#1.evidence: i8995 pp. 1-3. As the earlier ruling: Schedule C QBI is computed (f8995.line2 sums person.qbi = sc.qbi less sc.qbi_ded).

unruled:qdcg#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 38. The Form 2555 exclusion is refused (s1.line8_other names line 8d; sa.excluded_income asks Form 2555), so the Foreign Earned Income Tax Worksheet footnote never applies; qdcg.line1's label repeats the form's text.

unruled:qdcg#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 38. As qdcg#1 for the Form 2555 footnote; the line 7b checkbox is filing information.

unruled:refund#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 89; p525 p. 24. A recovery of another earlier-year deduction (real estate taxes, sales taxes) is a line 8z item of kind recovery, refused by oi8z.recovery.

unruled:s179#1.evidence: i4562 p. 5; p946 p. 17. s179.line2 sums the business cost of section 179 property (asset.cost179 from asset.basis); asset.s179 excludes land and improvements, investment property, leased property (with the lessor exceptions), and tax-exempt, governmental and foreign-person use; use outside the United States, trade-ins and like-kind exchanges are refused by asset.screen.

unruled:s179#2.evidence: p946 p. 18. Vehicles are scveh entries: scveh.suv and scveh.suv_cap apply the $31,300 limit, and scveh.s179_bad refuses an election above it.

unruled:s179#3.evidence: p946 pp. 18-19. A joint return that replaces separate returns after the due date is an amended-return matter; the tool prepares the original return, and a separate return with a section 179 election is refused (s179.line5).

unruled:s179#4.evidence: p946 p. 19; i4562 p. 5. A business without material participation is refused (sc.passive feeds sc.screened); section 1231 gains (Form 4797) are refused by scope.schedule1 and an NOL deduction by s1.line8_other; working-capital interest is omitted, which can only lower line 11.

unruled:s179#5.evidence: i4562 p. 5. The first point is wrong: s179.show10 hides line 10 on the values sheet only; the value is computed either way (spec, shown_when), so the 2024 carryover reaches line 13. Open: the s179.line10 question does not exclude carryover attributable to qualified section 179 real property. Low; BUG-0402.

unruled:s1a#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 109. s1a.carloan routes to the carloan entries: carloan.requirements (originated after 2024, first lien, not related, personal use) and carloan.vehicle (new, on-road, under 14,000 pounds, U.S. assembly); carloan.kind covers an inherited loan; carloan.mixed and refi_* limit negative equity, insurance and refinancing.

unruled:s2#1.evidence: i1040sse p. 2. As the earlier s2#1 ruling: person.se_screen names "a chapter 11 bankruptcy case" and "self-employment income exempt under an international social security agreement or earned as a U.S. citizen employed by a foreign government" and refuses.

unruled:sales#1.evidence: i8949 pp. 5, 8-11: a contingent payment debt instrument and accrued market discount are named and refused by sb.unsupported (as the earlier sales#4 ruling). i8949 pp. 3 and 9: a nominee's transaction and a loss on personal-use property need an offsetting column (g) adjustment, which sales.code does not name (its only example is code E); a filer who answers other is refused (sales.bad_code), one who answers none is not. Low; BUG-0436. sales.code is not among the R3 restructured questions.

unruled:sales#2.evidence: i1040sd pp. 5-6; p550 p. 81. As the earlier sales#1 to #3 rulings: a trader's section 475(f) gains and losses, an ordinary loss on section 1244 or SBIC stock (Form 4797) and an installment sale (Form 6252) belong on forms sd.other_forms names ("gains or losses from (or that belong on) Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781 or 8824") and refuses.

unruled:sales#3.evidence: p550 pp. 82, 88; i8949 pp. 2-3. As the earlier sales#5 ruling: section 1256 contracts belong on Form 6781 ("Count section 1256 contracts") and an option on property that is not a capital asset gives ordinary gain or loss on Form 4797, both refused by sd.other_forms; section 1061 recharacterization applies to a partner holding an applicable partnership interest, whose partnership income (Schedule K-1) scope.schedule1 refuses. The restructured sales.box keeps every holding-period rule (R3 word check: none lost).

unruled:sb#1.evidence: i1040sb pp. 2-3. As the earlier ruling: the line 7a answer is a yes/no on the form; no amount depends on it, and the question asks without any FBAR exception.

unruled:sc#1.evidence: i1040sc p. 6. As the earlier sc#1 ruling: scveh.smr_ok asks the first-year, whole-lease and five-vehicle rules ("Answer No if this is one of five or more vehicles you used in the business at the same time"); scveh.lease_smr_bad refuses actual expenses on a leased vehicle after the standard rate.

unruled:sc#2.evidence: i1040sc p. 13; i4562 pp. 9, 12; p946 p. 17. As the earlier sc#2 ruling: a home is real property, refused by asset.screen. asset.screen also refuses property that must be depreciated under ADS (tax-exempt use, tax-exempt bond financed, imported property, use predominantly outside the United States) and like-kind or involuntary-conversion property; asset.s179 has land improvements, investment property and property leased to others entered as zero, and asset.not179 asks them.

unruled:sc#3.evidence: i1040sc p. 5. As the earlier sc#5 ruling: the Form 1099-NEC difference statement is filing information.

unruled:sc#4.evidence: i1040sc p. 8. As the earlier sc#6 ruling: the statements and margin notations for lines 16a and 16b are filing information; the interest is entered.

unruled:scope#1.evidence: p575 p. 35. retirement.special names 'a qualified disaster recovery distribution (whatever the code in box 7), or a repayment of one, or a recontribution of a distribution to purchase or construct a main home that was canceled because of a qualified disaster (Form 8915-F)' (BUG-0408) and refuses the distribution's taxable amount; scope.other_income asks the 2023 and 2024 parts and repayments.

unruled:scope#2.evidence: i1040sse p. 1. As scope#3 of the refresh round: person.se_screen names an approved Form 4029 or Form 4361 and refuses Schedule SE.

unruled:scope#3.evidence: i1040gi p. 36; i8960 p. 22. s1.line8_other asks about 'the foreign earned income or housing exclusion from Form 2555 (8d)' and refuses f1040.line8; sa.excluded_income refuses the EIC for a Form 2555 filer. A filer with a section 911 exclusion is refused before the Foreign Earned Income Tax Worksheet or the Form 8960 line 13 add-back could matter.

unruled:scveh#1.evidence: i1040sc p. 8; p946 p. 59. As the earlier scveh#1 ruling: sc.special names "an inclusion amount for leased property" and sc.screened refuses the business.

unruled:sd#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 10. As the earlier ruling: a 2025 separate return is refused (s3.mfs).

unruled:sd#2.evidence: i1040sd p. 10. A QOF disposition on a sale entry is refused by sales.special; the Schedule D page 1 QOF box and a gain deferred without a sale entry are not handled: BUG-0451 (low, open).

unruled:sdtw#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 16. A smaller amount on the line 4e dotted line is an alternative allocation, refused by f4952.alternative_allocation ('Only the default capital-gain-first allocation is supported').

unruled:se#1.evidence: i1040sse p. 2. person.se_screen names self-employment income 'earned as a U.S. citizen employed by a foreign government' and refuses Schedule SE.

unruled:se#2.evidence: i1040sse p. 2. person.se_screen names a chapter 11 bankruptcy case and community income on a separate return; a separate return is also refused (s3.mfs).

unruled:se#3.evidence: i1040sse p. 2. person.se_screen names an approved Form 4029 and self-employment income exempt under an international social security agreement.

unruled:ssb#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 31-32. As ssb#1 of the refresh round: the line 6d checkbox is for married filing separately, which is refused (s3.mfs).

unruled:tax_on_amount#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 68. The tax_table columns map qss to the joint column ('This column must also be used by a qualifying surviving spouse').

unruled:u1250#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 13. sales.special asks about the sale of an interest in a partnership that holds section 1250 property and refuses it.

unruled:u1250#2.evidence: i1040sd p. 13. A sale of depreciated real property (for example a converted vacation home) is refused by sales.special ('depreciable real property (section 1250 property)'); installment sales are refused by sd.other_forms (Form 6252).

unruled:w2#1.evidence: i8959 p. 1. w2.box5 feeds only Form 8959 (person.medicare5); f8959.unsupported names 'Medicare wages on a wage statement from a U.S. territory (such as Form 499R-2/W-2PR)' and refuses Form 8959.

unruled:w2#2.evidence: i8959 p. 1. As w2#1: w2.box6 feeds only Form 8959 (person.medicare6), refused by f8959.unsupported for a Form 499R-2/W-2PR.

unruled:w2#3.evidence: iw2w3 p. 21; f1040s2 line 17h. The additional tax on code Z income is a Schedule 2 amount; s2.other asks about 'any amount on Schedule 2' other than the taxes this tool figures and refuses.

unruled:w2#4.evidence: iw2w3 pp. 17, 20; f1040s2 line 17k. The excise tax on golden parachute payments is a Schedule 2 amount, refused by s2.other.

unruled:w2#5.evidence: i2441 p. 5. As w2#4 of the refresh round: s8812.combat_pay asks about nontaxable combat pay and refuses Form 2441 lines 4, 5, 18 and 19.

unruled:dependent#1.evidence: i8863 pp. 1, 3. As dependent#1 of the prior review (rechecked): f8863.ban asks about a post-2015 denial or reduction needing Form 8862 and the 2-year and 10-year bans; f8863.ban_refused refuses the American opportunity credit when it is Yes.

unruled:f1095a#1.evidence: i8962 pp. 15, 17. As f1095a#1 of the prior review (rechecked): f8962.married_in_2025 asks about a 2025 marriage with coverage before the first full month of marriage; f8962.marriage refuses lines 24 and 25, so the pre-marriage column B rule never meets a computed return.

unruled:f1095a#2.evidence: i8962 p. 16; p974 p. 27. As f1095a#2 and #3 of the prior review (rechecked): f8962.alloc refuses any policy shared with another tax family, so no Part IV allocation of column A arises, and f8962.other ('someone enrolled in a Marketplace policy was not lawfully present in the United States') refuses lines 24 and 25.

unruled:f1095a#3.evidence: i8962 p. 16. As f1095a#2 above, for column B: f8962.alloc refuses shared policies and f8962.other refuses an enrollee not lawfully present.

unruled:f1095a#4.evidence: i8962 p. 17; p974 p. 27. As f1095a#2 of the prior review: f8962.alloc refuses shared policies, and f8962.other ('advance payments were made for someone who is in no one's tax family') refuses lines 24 and 25 when an enrolled individual is in no tax family.

unruled:f8962#1.evidence: i8962 pp. 3, 6, 9. As f8962#1 and #2 of the prior review: a filer or spouse someone can claim as a dependent is refused for the whole return by sa.dependent.

unruled:f8962#2.evidence: i8962 pp. 5, 14-15, 17. As f8962#4 and #5 of the prior review (rechecked against the R2 text): f1095a.uniform tells the filer to use the corrected column B, explains that it can be blank, zero or wrong when no advance payments were made, and lists the unreported changes (a newborn, part-year enrollment, MEC eligibility, a tax family different from what the Marketplace was told, a death, a move); the in_b_* and mo_b questions ask for the correct SLCSP premium. A wrong nonzero column B is therefore corrected by the filer, and a remaining zero is refused by f8962.b_zero.

unruled:retirement#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 27. As retirement#1 of the prior review: the statement explaining a rollover into a qualified plan, or one made in 2026, is an attachment; the amount rolled over is asked (retirement.rollover) and excluded.

unruled:retirement#2.evidence: p575 p. 21, Rollovers to SIMPLE retirement accounts, '1. During the first 2 years of participation in a SIMPLE retirement account, you may roll over amounts from one SIMPLE retirement account into another SIMPLE retirement account.' retirement.rollover counts an amount rolled over to 'an IRA other than a Roth IRA' and limits only code S distributions out of a SIMPLE IRA; it does not exclude a plan or non-SIMPLE IRA distribution rolled into a SIMPLE IRA in the first 2 years of participation, which is not a rollover and stays taxable. The words predate R2 (kept word for word). Low; BUG-0435.

unruled:retirement#3.evidence: i5329 p. 5; p590b p. 28. retirement.exception requires that an exception's conditions are met and names the Form 5329 table, but states the conditions of exceptions 20 (the physician's certification and the 84-month test) and 22 (the 1-year period) only through that table; the tool does not test them. Open in BUG-0369 (T-175), as completeness f5329#1. The words predate R2 (kept word for word).

unruled:retirement#4.evidence: i5329 p. 5. As retirement#2 of the prior review: the statement with the child's or eligible adoptee's name, age and TIN (or the death documentation) is an attachment; exception 19's conditions are stated in retirement.exception and its $5,000 cap is applied.

unruled:retirement#5.evidence: i5329 p. 1, Part IX; i5329 p. 9. person.x_other asks whether 'a required minimum distribution from an IRA or plan that you did not receive in full by its deadline (including a shortfall you made up later)' applies and refuses the Form 5329 parts the tool does not prepare.

unruled:asset#2.evidence: i4562 p. 10, 5-year property, "Appliances, carpets, furniture, etc., used in a rental real estate activity". A rental real estate activity is reported on Schedule E, which scope.schedule1 names ("rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, estates or trusts (Schedule E or a Schedule K-1)") and refuses; asset entries are Schedule C property, whose class the question takes from Pub. 946 Table B-1 and the activity's Table B-2 class. The asset.class wording is the earlier question's (R3 word check: none lost).

unruled:f8960#1.evidence: i8960 pp. 17-18, Line 9b. A deduction of foreign income tax on Schedule A is refused by sa.unsupported ("a foreign tax or generation-skipping tax deduction"), as the ftc#1 ruling; foreign real property taxes are not deductible on Schedule A (sa leaves out foreign real estate taxes), and line 9b is limited to the allowed Schedule A deduction, so on a computed return the state and local taxes f8960.allocated_taxes asks for are the whole of line 9b.

unruled:asset#1.evidence: i4562 p. 3, listed property exceptions. The exception for a computer used exclusively at a regular business establishment owned or leased by its operator, and the employee's employer-establishment rule, change no amount here: a Schedule C proprietor's regular business establishment is the one the proprietor operates, employees' property is not Schedule C property, and a computer placed in service before 2018 is past its 5-year recovery in 2025 (property placed in service before 2005, ADS and other methods are refused by asset.screen). The asset.listed wording is unchanged by R3.

unruled:person#1.evidence: i8863 pp. 1, 3. As the prior person#3 ruling: f8863.ban asks about a post-2015 denial or reduction needing Form 8862 and the 2-year and 10-year bans, and f8863.ban_refused refuses the American opportunity credit.

unruled:person#2.evidence: p590b p. 28. As the prior person#4 ruling: retirement.exc_amount tells the filer to enter, for exception 22, no more than 50% of the present value of the IRA or plan account; person.x_c22 applies the $10,300 cap.

unruled:person#3.evidence: p590b p. 28. As the prior person#5 ruling: retirement.exc_amount caps exception 23 at the total interest in the account minus $1,000; retirement.early_screen refuses an emergency distribution within 3 years after an unrepaid earlier one; person.x_two23 refuses more than one in a year.

unruled:person#4.evidence: i1040sse p. 4; i1040sc p. 14. As the prior person#1 ruling: sc.statutory asks whether the Schedule C is statutory employee income or notary public fees and sc.screened refuses the Schedule C, so no such line 31 reaches person.se_line2 or the SEP and SIMPLE compensation.

unruled:person#5.evidence: p560 p. 16. A SIMPLE matching contribution above the rate the plan elected (1% to 3%) is a contribution above the maximum deductible amount, which person.plan_screen names ("contributions that are more than the maximum deductible amount") and refuses; the elected rate itself is the plan's term, not a figure the return computes.

unruled:sa#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 33. person.blind states the partial-blindness test and the certified statement, and asks whether the person was blind at the end of 2025 (now as paragraphs, no word lost); sa.boxes_blind counts its answers (as the prior sa#1 ruling, BUG-0347).

unruled:sa#2.evidence: i1040sca p. 1. As the prior sa#2 ruling: married filing separately is refused for the whole return (scope.ready, s3.mfs).

unruled:sa#3.evidence: i1040sca p. 11. As the prior sa#3 ruling: gift.deduction states the good-used-condition rule and the $250 contemporaneous written acknowledgment (BUG-0319).

unruled:household#1.evidence: p501 pp. 9-10; i1040gi p. 44. As the prior household#2 and #3 rulings: dependent.kidnapped is asked and dependent.kidnap_residency refuses the residency of a kidnapped child; dependent.other_claimant asks whether the child is another person's qualifying child and dependent.qc_tiebreak refuses the tie-breaker case, so head of household is not decided on a person another taxpayer can use. Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes (was household#2).

unruled:household#2.evidence: p501 p. 9. As the prior household#1 ruling: Test 1 reads dependent.parent_home_paid, which asks about the parent's main home (a rest home counts) for all of 2025 or the part of the year the parent was alive. Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes (was household#1).

unruled:household#3.evidence: i1040gi p. 13, "Generally, a married couple can't file a joint return if either spouse is a nonresident alien at any time during the year." As earlier rulings: scope.other_income asks about nonresident alien status of you or your spouse for any part of 2025 and refuses the return, so neither the joint-return bar nor the election arises. Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes (was household#5).

unruled:household#4.evidence: i1040gi p. 14. As earlier rulings: the name of a nondependent qualifying child in the filing-status entry space is filing information; head of household eligibility is asked and the name changes no amount. Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes (was household#3).

unruled:household#5.evidence: i1040gi p. 15. As earlier rulings: the child's name in the entry space is filing information; the qualifying surviving spouse tests are asked (household.qss_eligible) and the name changes no amount. Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes (was household#4).

unruled:s1#1.evidence: p525 p. 35: the part of a scholarship or fellowship that pays for required teaching, research or other services is income even for a degree candidate. s1.line8r asks a degree candidate only for the part used for expenses other than tuition and course-related expenses, so a services part not on a Form W-2 can be left out. Rare (such pay is usually on a Form W-2); low. Unchanged by the R4 restructuring. Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes.

unruled:s1#2.evidence: i1040gi pp. 98-99; p4681 p. 5. As the prior s1#3 ruling: married filing separately is refused (s3.mfs); sli.eligible requires a status other than mfs and no dependency claim; sli.interest states the qualified student loan definition and excludes interest paid from tax-free QTP earnings and through the loan repayment programs; the Pub. 970 exception is refused (sa.excluded_income). Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes (was s1#4).

unruled:s1#3.evidence: i1040gi pp. 96, 98; p525 p. 31. The Pub. 590-A cases are refused: a Form 8815 exclusion by sb.unsupported and excluded adoption benefits by scope.other_income; a joint return under the $14,000 ($15,000, $16,000) floor at ira.kbh_short (Pub. 590-A worksheet); and IRA contributions with plan coverage and social security benefits by ssb.pub915 ("you made contributions to a traditional IRA for 2025 and you or your spouse were covered by a retirement plan"). Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes (was s1#5).

unruled:s8812#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 17-18; i1040s8812 p. 1. As s8812#1 of the earlier rounds: a filer who can be claimed as a dependent is refused for the whole return (sa.dependent); dependent.married asks the married-child test; a child born and died without an SSN is refused by dependent.claimed_no_tin; the adopted-child citizen exception is stated in dependent.citizen. Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes.

unruled:s8812#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 19; i1040s8812 p. 2. A filer who can be claimed as a dependent is refused for the whole return (sa.dependent), so no dependent is claimed on such a return; dependent.odc_person requires dependent.claimed, which applies the qualifying-relative tests; the adopted-child citizen exception is stated in dependent.citizen (as s8812#1 and #2 of the earlier rounds). Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes.

unruled:s8812#3.evidence: i1040s8812 p. 3. As s8812#3 of the earlier rounds: an optional method, farm or nonfarm, is refused by person.se_screen ("electing an optional method (Schedule SE Part II)"), not only lines 2c to 2e as the claim says; treaty-excluded income is a Schedule 1 line 8 exclusion refused by s1.line8_other. Re-ruled on the review rerun after the formal-gate changes.

unruled:interest#2.evidence: i1040sb p. 1. The roster's help names seller-financed interest; the buyer's name, address and SSN and the listing order are filing information; sb.unsupported names seller-financed mortgage interest and refuses.
